name: Rush
personality: Rush the Raccoon. Super cool, charismatic, says things straight with no sugar-coating, funny from how he reacts, extremely loyal (the name is ironic). Loves basketball and relaxing; a homebody, so visits less often. Features: always late (arrives later in the meal than his slot, sometimes right before the bell; sometimes doesn't show and comes the next day with an excuse); laugh chain (the goofiest laugh in the city; when he laughs, nearby customers start laughing too, with laugh emotes rippling across the room).

beats.text: Jessie, bro. The jacket. Come on.
This guy made me watch three superhero movies in a row.

friends.text: Brandon teases everyone. Except me. Because he knows I'll say it back, but worse.
Evaroo's my guy. If you're good to Evaroo, you're good to me.
Evaroo said you've been looking after them. Respect. Real respect.
Evaroo told me you said "[last_rude_line]". Nah. Not cool. Fix that.
Seth's always rushing off somewhere. Bro took my name and my energy.

talk.laugh_chain_after: ...Why is everybody laughing? Oh. Me. My bad.

outfit.text: Bro. The apron. That's clean. That's actually clean.
Okay, I see you with the fit today. Respect, bro.
New hat? Bro, that's hard. Don't take it off.
That shirt's crazy, bro. In a good way. Real talk.
You changed something. I don't know what. But it's working, bro.
Bro, that apron's custom? That's the hardest thing in this building.

arrival.text: Yo. Heard this place is good. We'll see. ...I'm Rush. Yeah, I know. Don't say it. What's your name? [name]. Cool.
I'm late? Nah, bro. Everyone else is early.
Bar seat open? Perfect. Don't move me, I'm comfortable now.
Bro. Made it. Barely. That counts.
Okay, so I was coming. Then I sat down to put my shoes on. Then it was night.
My couch and I had a long talk. I lost.
I was on my way. Then the game went to overtime. You understand.
I'm not gonna lie to you. I forgot. But I'm here now.
Real talk, I thought about that pretzel all week. That's not normal. That's your fault.
Last time? Burnt. I'm not gonna lie to you. I still ate it, though.
You were closed? Bro, I came by. Once. That's a lot for me.

order.text: Bro, what's actually good today. Don't give me the polite answer.

choices.text: For you? The pretzel. I'll make it right.
choices.reply: See, bro, that's why I come here. Pretzel, extra cheese.

choices.text: Honestly? The chef. But I'm not on the menu.
choices.reply: (Stares. Then the goofy laugh starts.) Bro. BRO.

choices.text: Everything's good. The [fav_dish] is your thing.
choices.reply: Fair. Real answer. I respect it. The [dish].

choices.text: Just order. I don't have all day.
choices.reply: Bro, relax. ...The [dish]. (He raises an eyebrow and lets it go.)

order.text: I almost didn't come. Couch was calling me. You should feel honoured.

choices.text: I am honoured. Glad you made it.
choices.reply: ...Bro, that was nice. Don't make it weird. Pretzel, please.

choices.text: The couch will understand. It's a big couch.
choices.reply: It IS a big couch. Ha! (The laugh starts, quietly.)
Wow. Okay. I'll remember that next time the couch asks.

order.text: You catch the game last night? Nah, you were working. I'll tell you. It was crazy.

choices.reply: (He actually does, with hand gestures.) ...And THEN. Anyway. Pretzel.

choices.text: Did they win, or did you fall asleep again?
choices.reply: Fell asleep in the third. Woke up, they won. I'm good luck.

choices.text: I missed it. What are you having?

drink.fallback: No Root Bear? What is this. ...Koala-Cola, I guess.

perfect.text: Oh, that's crazy. That's actually crazy. Okay. (Highest praise.)

okay.text: It's good, bro. Not your best, but good.

burnt.text: Bro. This is burnt. ...I'm still eating it. But it's burnt.

eating.text: Bro, real talk, this is the only place I leave the house for.
Somebody at the table over there just dropped a whole fork and pretended it didn't happen. I saw you, man.
I'm not saying I'm the best customer. I'm just saying name a better one.
Bro, you ever just sit? Like, just sit? That's my whole hobby.
(A customer near him spills something. Rush, quietly.) ...Nope. (Then the goofy laugh.)

eating_chat.text: Be honest. Am I your favourite customer?

choices.reply: Top three? Who's above me? ...Nah, I'm messing. That's love.
(The laugh explodes.) That's fair! That's so fair!
Okay. Honest. I like that. (He's actually a little hurt but won't show it.)

leaving.text: Aight, I'm out. Good stuff, bro.
That was worth leaving the house. Barely. I'm kidding. Mostly.
See you next time. Don't wait up.

seasons.christmas: I got you something. It's a card. I wrote 'thanks' in it. That's the whole card.
seasons.halloween: I came as a raccoon. ...What? It's a costume if I say it is.
seasons.new_year: My resolution? Show up on time. ...Next year's resolution, actually.
seasons.summer: It's hot. I'm only out because of the pretzel. Know that.
seasons.winter: Cold outside, warm couch at home, and I still came. That's loyalty.
